name: job_status
description: Check the status and results of an async job. Returns instantly. For non-terminal jobs the response includes poll_after_seconds — wait that many seconds before calling again. Typical total times: image ~10-20s, video ~60-180s.

jobId.description: Job ID from a previous operation

sync.description: If true, server polls internally for up to ~25s and returns on terminal state. Defaults to false.

raw_data.description: If true, return the raw FNF job payload instead of the normalized generation shape.

source.description: Set by the generation widget when it polls automatically.
